title: P-Image
description: Pruna AI P-Image — an optimised Qwen-based text-to-image model generating 1-megapixel images in about a second. Built for rapid iteration at very low cost.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. This model returns a single image per request.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate. The model automatically enhances prompts for better results.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.
